answer.generated: Real memory acts as an intermediate level between virtual memory and physical memory, as described in Appendix Title A Instruction Set Principles. This architecture involves the guest operating system mapping virtual memory to real memory through its page tables, while the virtual memory management system (VMM) further maps the guest's real memory to physical memory using its own page tables. This hierarchical approach ensures efficient memory management and translation, facilitating the operation of virtualized environments where multiple virtual machines share the same physical hardware resources.
